title: Recessed Toilet Paper Holder 6.125-Inch Square | Autumn Sparkle | Carolina | Allied Brass
description:
Create a built-in look and reclaim space around the toilet with a recessed toilet paper holder in Autumn Sparkle, which captures the rich, warm tones of fall foliage with subtle shimmer, bringing seasonal warmth year-round. This wall-mounted, in-wall toilet paper holder (also called a toilet tissue holder or toilet roll holder) from the Carolina collection is designed to coordinate with traditional bathroom hardware and classic bath accessories.

Highlights:
- Autumn Sparkle transforms this essential into a conversation piece
- Choose from 28 designer finishes to match the rest of your bathroom
- Match your bath decor with the Carolina collection for matching Carolina accessories and heritage bathroom fixtures
- Straightforward installation: coordinating mounting hardware is included

Specs & Installation:
- Product dimensions (L x H x W): 6.125 x 6.125 x 4 in.
- Box dimensions (L x H x W): 10 x 6 x 4 in.
- Shipping weight: 2.4 lbs
- Mounting style: recessed/in-wall; wall mount / wall-mounted / wall hanging application using concealed screws
multiple designer finish options available
- Warranty: limited lifetime warranty
